title: AI/ML Research Intern
description: Research-focused AI/ML internship with focus on NLP and LLM. Great for recent graduates or master's students aiming for PhD.
why_good_fit: Strong alignment with NLP, LLM, and research-oriented candidates. MeghOps focuses on product research and AI implementation.
requirements: Recent graduate or master's student in CS/Data Science. Strong NLP and LLM knowledge. Deep learning frameworks experience.
career_path: Intern → Junior ML Engineer → ML Engineer → Senior ML Engineer → Research Scientist
jd_text: MeghOps is seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Research Intern to join our team. This role is ideal for recent graduates, master's students aiming to pursue a PhD in AI/ML, or fourth-year bachelor's students with a strong background in AI/ML and some publication experience. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in AI/ML, particularly in NLP and LLM, to assist in product research and AI implementation in our product. Key responsibilities include conducting research in AI/ML with focus on NLP and LLM, assisting in development and validation of ML algorithms, analyzing complex datasets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

title: Junior ML Engineer
description: Computer vision and embedded ML role. Work with image/video processing and edge devices like Raspberry Pi, Nvidia Jetson.
why_good_fit: Perfect for candidates interested in computer vision, embedded systems, and real-world ML deployment.
requirements: BSc in CS or outstanding students with CV/ML projects. 1+ year experience. Advanced Python, TensorFlow, hardware knowledge.
career_path: Junior ML Engineer → ML Engineer → Senior ML Engineer → Computer Vision Lead
jd_text: Bondstein Technologies is hiring a Junior Machine Learning Engineer. Responsibilities include developing image and video processing solutions, designing machine learning models, researching and implementing ML algorithms, gathering and preparing datasets for training, image/video/audio processing, object classification and detection. Requirements: BSc in Computer Science (or outstanding students with CV/ML projects), 1+ year experience, Python (advanced level), TensorFlow, Deep Learning frameworks, hardware knowledge including Raspberry Pi, Nvidia Jetson, STM32.

title: Junior ML Engineer
description: Work with Data Science team on ML solutions. Financial backing from Fleet Group.
why_good_fit: Great for candidates with 1-2 years experience in ML/Data Science. Cloud deployment skills are a bonus.

career_path: Junior ML Engineer → ML Engineer → Senior ML Engineer → Lead Data Scientist
jd_text: Data Insightopia is looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer to work with the Data Science team on ML solutions. You will develop and deploy machine learning models, work on analytics projects, and handle model training and evaluation. Requirements include 1-2 years experience in ML/Data Science, Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), Git version control. Bonus points for cloud deployment experience (AWS, GCP, Azure), MLOps knowledge, and basic front-end skills. The position offers 30,000-40,000 BDT/month with financial backing from Fleet Group.

title: AI Engineer Intern
description: Night shift internship focused on LLM, RAG, and LangChain. Work directly with CTO.
why_good_fit: Ideal for candidates passionate about LLMs, RAG systems, and modern AI stacks. Night shift requires flexibility.
requirements: CS/Engineering student or graduate. Knowledge of RAG, fine-tuning, LangChain, prompt engineering, Llama 3, vector databases.
career_path: Intern → AI Engineer → Senior AI Engineer → AI Lead → CTO track
jd_text: EkkBaz.AI is hiring an AI Engineer Intern for night shift. You will assist in AI/LLM model development, use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and fine-tuning techniques, develop and optimize prompts for LLMs, utilize Llama 3 or other open-source LLMs, work with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB), and collaborate directly with CTO on AI projects. Requirements include knowledge of RAG and/or fine-tuning techniques, experience with LangChain framework, prompt engineering skills, familiarity with Llama 3 or other open-source LLMs, and experience with vector databases.

title: AI Intern

why_good_fit: Good for candidates interested in industrial AI applications. Experience with LLMs (Ollama, GPT) is a plus.
requirements: BSc in CSE/IT. 1-2 years experience. Python, SQL, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch. LLM experience preferred.

Requirements include BSc in Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology, 1-2 years experience, Python and SQL programming, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and experience with LLMs (Ollama, GPT).

title: Data Scientist
description: Entry-level Data Scientist role. Analyze large amounts of raw information to find patterns.
why_good_fit: Good for candidates with proven experience in data mining, machine learning, and R/SQL/Python.
requirements: Proven experience as Data Scientist/Analyst. Data mining, ML, R/SQL/Python, BI tools (Tableau), strong math skills.
career_path: Data Scientist → Senior Data Scientist → Lead Data Scientist → Head of Analytics
jd_text: LifePlus Bangladesh is looking for a Data Scientist to analyze large amounts of raw information to find patterns that will help improve our company. You will identify valuable data sources and automate collection processes, undertake preprocessing of structured and unstructured data, analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns, build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms, combine models through ensemble modeling, present information using data visualization techniques, propose solutions and strategies to business challenges, and collaborate with engineering and product development teams.

jd_text: Projahnmo Research Foundation (PRF) in association with Johns Hopkins University, USA is seeking a Junior Bioinformatician. You will learn and apply bioinformatics tools and software to perform basic analyses such as gene expression analysis, variant calling, and sequence alignment.
